scope_note: Every figure on this page is computed over that scope only, before any grouping.
scope_none_body: Your account currently governs nobody. Ask an administrator to widen your scope to see these analyses.
kp_subtitle: The capabilities exactly one person carries — by name, with their site and role.
kp_intro: A skill × org-unit sweep. For every role requirement it compares the required level against the people actually assessed at that level.
kp_band_sole_holder_help: Exactly one person assessed at the required level. This is the key-person risk.
kp_band_no_qualified_help: People were assessed; none reaches the required level. A real, evidenced gap.
kp_band_never_measured_help: Nobody here has ever been assessed on this skill. That is an UNKNOWN, not a gap — it is never counted as risk.
kp_never_measured_note: No assessment to date — unknown, not a gap.
kp_empty_title: No sole holder in this scope
kp_empty_body: No skill required here is carried by a single assessed person. Try "All states" or widen the filter to see unknowns and measured gaps.
kp_empty_never_hint: {n} pairs have never been assessed here: their state is unknown until an assessment happens.
kp_unknown_banner: {n} critical requirements in this scope have never been assessed. They appear as "Never measured" and are deliberately counted neither as covered nor as at risk.
se_subtitle: The sites side by side: readiness, continuity, certifications.
se_intro: One row per site, each column being the dashboard indicator for that site: the page cannot contradict it.
se_readiness_null_help: No requirement assessed at this site — no percentage can be shown.
se_empty_body: Nobody in your scope is attached to a site. As soon as an assignment exists, this table fills in.
se_footnote: Each column is the dashboard indicator for that site (same definitions, population and colours); the total row is the organisation’s indicator, never a sum of percentages. Under 5 people: counts, never a percentage or a status. « Average readiness » is the mean of the people (K2), at most 100 %.
se_all_sole_note: « All » counts every skill of the workforce, critical or not: it is not the « Sole holders » indicator, which only counts critical skills.
se_weakest_two: Fewest people fully ready: {{ready}} ({{rv}}, {{rn}} of {{rd}}). Lowest level against the requirement: {{level}} ({{lv}}). Two measures, two questions.
se_weakest_one: {{site}} is lowest on both measures: people fully ready ({{rv}}) and level against the requirement ({{lv}}).
bp_subtitle: A print-ready brief for the committee.
bp_no_trend: No recorded history yet. The daily snapshot feeds this section; the first point will appear at the next snapshot.
bp_trend_single: One recorded snapshot only ({a}, {x} %) — no comparison possible yet.
bp_keyperson_hidden: Section reserved for holders of a continuity grant.
bp_no_keyperson: No sole holder identified in this scope.
bp_action_designate: Designate the critical positions still unscored, so succession coverage can be computed.
bp_action_assess: Start assessing the {n} critical requirements never measured — their state is unknown today.
bp_action_bench: Open a succession plan for the {n} sole-holder skills identified (the table above shows an extract only).
bp_action_certs: Handle the {n} certifications expiring within 90 days.
bp_footnote: Figures computed over the stated scope. "Not measured" values are left blank and are never treated as zero.
bd_subtitle: What the committee decided on this pack, who owns it (a role, never a person) and where it stands. A decision is never changed or deleted: only its follow-up moves.
bd_scope_note: the decisions of this scope only.
bd_unavailable: Decisions are not available yet (database migration 197).
bd_readonly: Read-only: your account cannot record or follow decisions.
bd_field_text_hint: One sentence. Name a role, never a person: a text that names someone is refused, because a decision can never be rewritten.
bd_field_owner_hint: The role that carries it out.
bd_field_kpi_hint: Optional: the pack then shows how it moved since the decision.
bd_field_pack_hint: The date of the pack the decision was taken on.
bd_none: No decision recorded for this scope yet.
bd_field_state_note_hint: Required to drop a decision: say why.
bd_state_confirm: The change is kept in the history and cannot be undone.
bd_state_confirm_title: Change the state of this decision?
bd_err_decided_at: The decision date is not a valid date.
bd_err_decided_future: A decision cannot be dated in the future.
bd_err_pack_date: The pack date is not a valid date.
bd_err_due_date: The due date is not a valid date.
bd_err_due_before: The due date cannot be before the decision.
bd_err_reason_required: Say why the decision is dropped.
bd_err_same_state: The decision is already in this state.
bd_err_person_name: The text names a person. Name a role instead: a decision can never be rewritten.
bd_err_scope: This scope is not yours: nothing was recorded.
bp_targets_note: The gap and « reached » are decided on the values as printed. No target is « no target », never a zero.
bp_targets_no_scope: Targets apply to the organisation or a whole site: this scope has none.
bp_since_first: First recorded pack for this scope: the next one will compare with it.
bp_since_first_today: This pack was recorded today: the next meeting will compare with it.
bp_since_unavailable: Recorded packs are not available yet (database migration 198).
bp_since_compared: Compared with the pack recorded on {{date}}.
bp_since_definitions: The indicator definitions changed since that pack: no change is printed, the figures are not comparable.
bp_since_shared: This pack is the shared pack of the whole unit.
bp_since_own: You do not see the whole unit: your recorded packs and decisions are kept apart from the shared ones.
bp_record_hint: Keeps what this pack says today, so the next pack compares with it. Opening or printing writes nothing.
bp_record_confirm: The figures of this pack are kept as presented and cannot be changed.
bp_flash_recorded: Pack recorded: the next pack of this scope compares with it.
bp_decisions_none: No open decision, and none closed since the last pack.
bp_k17_line: Median wait for a validation: {{median}} days ({{n}} approvals).
bp_k17_beyond: Fewer than half of the submissions are decided: the median is beyond {{days}} days.
bp_k17_small: {{n}} approvals: too few for a median.
bp_k17_backlog: Waiting now: {{total}} people, {{late}} for more than 7 days.
bp_k20_line: {{exposed}} of {{covered}} people under a legally mandatory safety rule do not meet it ({{fail}} known shortfall, {{missing}} evidence missing).
bp_k20_small: Fewer than 5 people under a legally mandatory safety rule: no figure is printed.
bp_k19_line: {{leavers}} departures in 12 months; {{ready}} were ready for their role, {{sole}} held a critical skill alone on their site.
bp_k19_insufficient: Capability lost to departures: insufficient history (captured from the first departure processed after this version).
bp_k19_small: Fewer than 5 departures: no figure is printed.
kp_truncated: This table shows only the first {shown} of the {total} sole-holder skills identified. The full list is under Continuity → Key-person risk.
